title: Nightlight Frond

sources.title: Essence of Nightlight
markers: | description = '''Essence of Nightlight''' is an [[Alchemy|Alchemical Extraction]]. It can be combined with any [[Alchemy#Extractions|Suspension]] to create a {{SmRarityItem|Hearthlight Bomb}}.

sources.title: Hearthlight Bomb
markers: | description = '''Hearthlight Bomb''' is a [[Consumables|Consumable]] ([[Grenades|Grenade]]) item which can be {{SAI|throw|thrown}}.

summary: Extract three Nightlight Fronds into Essence of Nightlight. Mix the essence with any Suspension to make a Hearthlight Bomb.

fields.Harvest: DC 12 Nature check on Underdark Nightlight mushrooms. Also sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony.
fields.Crafted bomb: Throw as an Action to illuminate a 30 ft radius for 10 turns.
fields.Base value: 2 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Crafting: Extract three Nightlight Fronds into Essence of Nightlight. Combine the essence with any Suspension to make a Hearthlight Bomb.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
